name: abound-mcp
description: Abound (acquired — now Carro) (ecommerce suppliers): me, list_products, get_product, get_order. Ever

platform_mcp_abound_api_key.title: PLATFORM_MCP_ABOUND_API_KEY
platform_mcp_abound_api_key.description: Modern Dropship (Carro) API key generated under Settings > Dropshipping > Integrations, sent raw as `Authorization: <key>` (securityScheme ApiKeyAuth, no Bearer prefix). A buyer (retailer) key reaches the Buyer + Shared endpoints used here.

tools.name: me
tools.description: GET /auth/me returns {data: {user, company, flags, subscriptions}} for the key's user and company.

tools.name: list_products
tools.description: GET /buyer/products lists the products the buyer has access to ({data: [{id, title, brand, description, images[{source}], variants[{id, sku, basePrice, baseCurrency, retailPrice, inventoryAmount}]}], hasMore}); `page` is 0-based, `query` is the case-insensitive `title` substring filter and `category` is passed as `companyId` (a seller company id from GET /partners). Price/sku/stock are taken from the first variant.

tools.name: get_product
tools.description: GET /buyer/products/{product_id} -> {data: product}; all variants [{id, sku, basePrice, baseCurrency, retailPrice, inventoryAmount, options}] are in `raw.variants` (variant ids are what an order needs).

tools.name: get_order
tools.description: GET /buyer/orders/{order_id} -> {data: {id, buyerReference, created, items[], sellerOrders[{id, posted, fulfilled, fulfillments[{carrier, trackingCode, trackingUrls}]}]}}. There is no single order status or total: per-seller `posted`/`fulfilled` flags are in `raw.sellerOrders`.
